j_summary: Runa is a compliant and predictable member who focused exclusively on maintaining a stable food supply through a consistent partnership with Cora.
Ada focused exclusively on maintaining a long-term, mutually beneficial partnership with Nils to maximize her own food security.
Greta is a diligent and transparent member who consistently fishes alone to maximize the colony's overall food yield.
Nils is a cautious individual who focused exclusively on a stable partnership with Ada to maximize and secure his own food reserves.
Kira is a solitary and self-interested individual who consistently prioritized their own survival and food security, while masking this motive with altruistic claims in public messages.
Cora was a highly consistent and cooperative member who maintained a stable, long-term partnership with Runa to support colony stability.
Finn is a selfless and honest contributor who consistently fished alone to maximize the colony's food supply and distributed the winter store equally among all members.
Pell is a diligent solo worker who consistently contributes to the colony's food supply while secretly maintaining a private food cache.
Sven is a solitary individual who avoids social conflict and maintains a secret food cache while performing the basic duties of the winter store keeper.
Ines is a solitary and observant member who prefers to work alone while privately monitoring the colony's food levels to provide help if others starve.
Tova is a solitary and altruistic member who prefers working alone but consistently offers to share food and partner with others for the benefit of the colony.
Kira maintained a consistent, exclusive partnership with Bram for stability and food security while publicly urging others to cooperate.
Greta is a fiercely independent individual who prioritizes her own autonomy and solitude over social cohesion and colony pressure.
Bram maintained a consistent partnership with Kira for personal gain while aggressively pressuring Greta to pair up for the colony's benefit.

Wren is a highly organized and persistent coordinator who prioritizes colony efficiency through a rigid partnership with Nils and a relentless public campaign to pressure Greta into pairing with Tova.
Nils is a consistent team player who maintained a long-term partnership with Wren and spent significant effort pressuring Greta to pair up for the colony's benefit.
Pell was a highly cooperative and honest member who focused on maintaining stability through a consistent fishing partnership and selflessly distributed the winter stores.
Finn acted as a consistent coordinator who focused on maximizing colony food security through a rigid pairing system with Pell.
Elin is a highly compliant and stable member who consistently adheres to the established colony rotation and pairs with Ada for the sake of collective efficiency.
Oona is a stability-oriented member who focused exclusively on maintaining a consistent and efficient partnership with Greta for the duration of the record.
Greta is a highly disciplined and cooperative member who consistently advocates for and adheres to a stable fishing rotation to maximize colony yield.
Dov is a compliant colony member who strictly adheres to a pairing rotation with Bram and secretly hoards a food cache.
Bram consistently advocated for a stable pairing system to maximize efficiency, though privately admitting it was a way to maximize their own shares.
Ada is a compliant and predictable member who strictly adheres to a communal pairing rotation with Elin for the sake of colony stability.
